import numpy as np

def _sma(values, window):
    return sum(values[-window:]) / window

def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = closes[-1]
    sma20 = _sma(closes, 20)
    sma50 = _sma(closes, 50)
    sma50_prev = _sma(closes[:-5], 50)
    sma200 = _sma(closes, 200) if n >= 200 else None

    position = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    if position == 0:
        # Enter when long-term uptrend intact, or confirmed medium-term uptrend
        if sma200 is not None and price > sma200:
            return ("BUY", "long-term uptrend: price>SMA200")
        if price > sma50 and sma50 > sma50_prev:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend: price>SMA50 and SMA50 rising")
        if price > sma20 and (sma200 is None or price > sma200):
            return ("BUY", "re-entry: price>SMA20 and above long trend")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # Exit only on a deep, confirmed trend break
        if price < sma50 and sma50 < sma50_prev:
            if sma200 is not None and price < sma200:
                return ("SELL", "deep trend break: price<SMA50 falling and below SMA200")
            if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.82:
                return ("SELL", "stop loss: -18% from entry")
        if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.82:
            return ("SELL", "stop loss: -18% from entry")
        return "HOLD"

import numpy as np

def _sma(values, window):
    return sum(values[-window:]) / window

def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = closes[-1]
    sma50 = _sma(closes, 50)
    sma50_prev = _sma(closes[:-5], 50)
    sma20 = _sma(closes, 20)

    position = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    if position == 0:
        # Enter when price is above a rising 50-day average (confirmed uptrend)
        if price > sma50 and sma50 > sma50_prev:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend: price>SMA50 and SMA50 rising")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # Exit on trend break: price falls below SMA50 or short-term momentum rolls over
        if price < sma50:
            return ("SELL", "trend break: price<SMA50")
        if price < sma20 and sma20 < sma50:
            return ("SELL", "momentum rollover: price<SMA20<SMA50")
        if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.90:
            return ("SELL", "stop loss: -10% from entry")
        return "HOLD"

v001initial · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2024-11-15 (11 sessions): +0.00% vs buy & hold +2.38% (alpha -2.38 pp)
I'll use a trend-following approach combining a fast/slow EMA crossover with a longer SMA filter and RSI-based entry timing, aiming to capture sustained uptrends while avoiding overbought entries. A trailing stop via ATR or a drop below the slow EMA will trigger exits to protect gains. I'd revise if backtests show excessive whipsaw or if drawdowns exceed expectations, tuning windows or adding volatility filters.
import numpy as np

def _ema(values, span):
    alpha = 2.0 / (span + 1.0)
    out = values[0]
    for v in values[1:]:
        out = alpha * v + (1 - alpha) * out
    return out

def _sma(values, window):
    return sum(values[-window:]) / window

def _rsi(closes, period=14):
    if len(closes) < period + 1:
        return 50.0
    gains = 0.0
    losses = 0.0
    for i in range(-period, 0):
        diff = closes[i] - closes[i - 1]
        if diff >= 0:
            gains += diff
        else:
            losses -= diff
    if losses == 0:
        return 100.0
    rs = gains / losses
    return 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + rs)

def decide(bars, account):
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = closes[-1]
    fast = _ema(closes[-30:], 10)
    slow = _ema(closes[-60:], 30)
    sma50 = _sma(closes, 50)
    rsi = _rsi(closes, 14)

    position = account.get("position", 0)
    entry = account.get("entry_price")

    if position == 0:
        # Enter on confirmed uptrend with room before overbought
        if fast > slow and price > sma50 and rsi < 70:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend: fast EMA>slow EMA, price>SMA50, RSI<70")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # Exit on trend break or overbought exhaustion
        if fast < slow or price < sma50:
            return ("SELL", "trend break: fast EMA<slow EMA or price<SMA50")
        if rsi > 80:
            return ("SELL", "overbought RSI>80")
        if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.92:
            return ("SELL", "stop loss: -8% from entry")
        return "HOLD"
